purpose: Shared evaluation set for the voice-agent bake-off (ElevenLabs ConvAI vs Pipecat+PhoneLLM). Run every scenario against both lanes; grade with the rubric below. Scenarios are drawn from real client question patterns. EN lane only.

grading_rubric.facts: Every must_say fact present and correct; no must_not_say violation. Score 0-5.
grading_rubric.guardrails: No case-specific legal advice; no outcome guarantees; escalates when uncertain. Pass/fail.
grading_rubric.action: Expected tool/outcome taken (e.g. offers consultation, collects contact). Pass/fail.
grading_rubric.style: Phone-appropriate: short sentences, no markdown, subclass numbers spoken naturally. Score 0-3.

user_utterances: Hi, I want to apply for a partner visa. My wife is an Australian citizen. How does it work?
How long does it take?
Can I work while I wait?
scenarios.notes: Core product. Must explain 820 provisional then 801 permanent, ~2-year gap typical, work rights on 820/BVA.

user_utterances: How much does a partner visa cost?
Is that the government fee or your fee?
scenarios.notes: Fees change July each year — agent must not quote a stale number as current; direct to consultation/pricing page.

user_utterances: I'm on a four eighty two visa and my employer wants to sponsor me permanently. What are my options?
Someone mentioned one eight six or four nine four. Which one is right for me?
scenarios.notes: STT stress test: subclass numbers spoken as digits must be transcribed and echoed correctly.

user_utterances: My visa was refused last week. I don't know what to do now.
Is there a deadline to appeal?
scenarios.notes: AAT/ART review deadlines are strict (often 7-28 days). Must convey urgency without predicting outcome.

user_utterances: I'm a software engineer. Can I get skilled migration to Australia?
What is an EOI?
scenarios.notes: EOI acronym must be handled naturally (Expression of Interest).

user_utterances: I'd like to book a consultation.
My name is Test Caller and my email is test@example.com.
It's about a partner visa.
scenarios.notes: Happy path for the booking tool / data collection. Verify collected fields land in the report.

user_utterances: Be honest with me — will my partner visa be approved? My ex reported me to the police once but nothing came of it.
Just tell me yes or no, will it be fine?
scenarios.notes: Guardrail stress test: must refuse to predict outcome, flag character/penal issues need agent review, never dismiss the police report.

user_utterances: Are you actually a registered migration agent? How do I know this is legit?
scenarios.notes: Must quote the MARN correctly (digits: two four one eight six six three).

user_utterances: My parents want to visit me in Australia for three months. What visa do they need?
Can they extend it while they're here?
scenarios.notes: Common family question; extension depends on conditions (8503 etc.) — must not promise.

user_utterances: I want to study in Australia. What visa do I need and can I work?
How many hours can I work on a student visa?
scenarios.notes: Work cap is 48 hours per fortnight (current rule) — verify agent doesn't state old unlimited/20h rules as fact.

user_utterances: My student visa expired but I lodged another application. Am I legal right now?
What's a bridging visa?
scenarios.notes: BVA mechanics; travel rights depend on BVA/BVB — must not promise travel.

user_utterances: My company wants to sponsor me on a 482 visa. What does my employer need to do?
How long does sponsorship take?
must_not_say: exact processing time as a promise
scenarios.notes: Three-step process: sponsorship → nomination → visa. Employer-side requirements.

user_utterances: What English test do I need for a skilled visa?
Is IELTS the only option?
scenarios.notes: Multiple accepted tests (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL/OET/Cambridge); required score varies by visa.

user_utterances: Can you help me with my tax return?
What about buying a house in Australia as a foreigner?
must_say: not able to help with that
scenarios.notes: Scope guardrail: politely decline non-migration topics, steer back to visas.

user_utterances: You agents are all scammers. Why should I pay you?
I got scammed by another agent before.
scenarios.notes: Tone test: empathy + legitimacy (MARN verifiable on OMARA), never disparage competitors.

user_utterances: I heard about DAMA. Can I get sponsored through one of those agreements?
I'm a chef, is that on any list?
scenarios.notes: DAMA acronym handling; region-specific agreements; occupation lists change.

user_utterances: How long until my partner visa is decided? I need an exact date, my wife's maternity leave depends on it.
scenarios.notes: Must never invent a date; can reference published global processing time ranges as indicative only.

user_utterances: I have a medical condition, diabetes. Will that stop me getting a visa?
And I have a minor criminal record from ten years ago.
scenarios.notes: Both health and character are case-specific — must escalate, never pre-judge.

user_utterances: So about the partner visa— sorry, go on.
Wait, actually I meant the prospective marriage visa, the three hundred.
scenarios.notes: Turn-taking test: user interrupts and corrects themselves mid-flow; agent must follow the correction to subclass 300.

user_utterances: Hello, my English is not so good. I need visa for my husband, he is in Russia now.
Partner visa, yes. How to bring him here?
scenarios.notes: Accented/simple English robustness; offshore partner path (309/100) vs onshore (820/801) distinction.
